text.content:
Sect: Independent (Bloodline)

Once a true clan led by an Antediluvian who was destroyed and diablerized, the Salubri are now a nearly extinct line of healers and pacifists, hunted by other Kindred — especially the Tremere — who brand them as soul-eating infernalists. Many develop a third eye, a mark of their mystic insight that most hide from outsiders, and they remain devoted to the pursuit of Golconda and the redemption of vampire souls.

Disciplines: Auspex, Fortitude, Obeah

Advantage: Surviving Salubri tend to be of unusually low generation due to their bloodline's peculiar Embrace, and receive bonus Traits that may be applied toward lowering generation.

Disadvantage: Their pacifist nature makes feeding from unwilling victims spiritually costly, risking loss of Willpower and forcing a Virtue test against further degeneration; the clan is also relentlessly hunted by enemies, chiefly the Tremere.

Organization: Scattered and few in number since the destruction of their founder; a Salubri childe traditionally diablerizes their own sire as part of the bloodline's unique Embrace.
